Name: Initialize Disk
Description: Initialize a new or RAW disk with GPT or MBR partition style. Required before creating partitions on a new disk.

Params.name: InitInfo
Params.default:
Initialize a RAW disk before creating partitions.
- GPT: Recommended for modern systems, supports disks >2TB
- MBR: Legacy systems, limited to 2TB disks
- Only RAW (uninitialized) disks can be initialized
- This operation does not erase data, but prepares disk structure

Params.name: DiskNumber
Params.label: Select Disk
Params.description: Select the disk to initialize (must be RAW/uninitialized)

Params.name: PartitionStyle
Params.label: Partition Style
Params.description: GPT recommended for modern systems and disks >2TB
